notes.title: Narcalid Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/789b63e2d8e94eaf56094d45478fa365f78acf2d.png
Hi everyone! We are delighted to share that Narcalid is now available for Early Access! 

This serene, co-op Metroidvania-inspired side-scroller invites you to explore its tranquil and enlightening world.

Narcalid is a labor of love, crafted with the intention of offering players a peaceful and immersive adventure. Whether you're journeying solo or with friends, you'll discover a beautifully designed environment filled with intriguing secrets and harmonious challenges, and we couldn't be more excited for you to join us. 

So, take a moment to immerse yourself in the serene world of Narcalid. We hope it brings you as much joy and tranquility as it has brought us in creating it. 

Dive into Narcalid today and let the adventure begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341110/Narcalid/

notes.title: Narcalid Early Access is Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Enlightened Travelers,

First and foremost, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for your incredible support and enthusiasm. Your positive energy fuels our journey.

We are excited to share that Narcalid will be available for Early Access starting August 8th! This is a significant milestone for us, and we can't wait for you to embark on this peaceful and enlightening adventure.

In Narcalid, you will team up with friends to heal a fractured planet, facing epic yet beautiful challenges and exploring beautiful, serene landscapes. Your journey will be guided by themes of joy, unity, and spiritual growth.

[previewyoutube=ULYYyiZ3SPg;full][/previewyoutube]

How You Can Help:

 Join the Adventure: Dive into Narcalid on August 8th and experience the tranquility and harmony we've crafted.
 Share Your Feedback: Visit our Steam Discussion Page and let us know your thoughts. Your insights are invaluable in shaping the future of Narcalid.
Connect with Us: Join our Discord Server to ask questions, share your experiences, and interact directly with the developers.
 Support Us: Please consider adding Narcalid to your wishlist on Steam. Your support helps us continue to grow and improve the game, and ensures you stay updated with all our latest progress and features. 

Thank you once again for being part of this journey. We are deeply grateful for your support and can't wait for you to experience Narcalid.

With peace and gratitude,
The Lotus Mountain Team

notes.title: Narcalid's Enlightement #2 - Characters
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/789b63e2d8e94eaf56094d45478fa365f78acf2d.png

It's time to meet some of the characters that you will control and meet during your enlightenment adventure on Narcalid!

Main Ambassadors
Mey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/255ceb4eca4bc328588fdc9b6c9504976f1c4c35.png
Mey Santillan is a skilled and empathetic psychologist from the Principality of Inca Tau, now serving aboard the SS Awakening. Her journey from a manipulative youth to a dedicated healer reflects her deep commitment to helping others. Despite her struggles with control, Mey's expertise and calming influence make her an essential member of the crew in the world of Narcalid.

Tahok
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/2002afe55fe18bcd98202806f53a84082907a923.png
Tahok Watike is a dedicated and optimistic cryptologist from the Republic of New Haven, serving aboard the SS Awakening. His journey is driven by a love for the ocean, a fascination with history, and a determination to find his missing brother. Despite his naivety and impulsiveness, Tahok's resilience and unshakeable spirit make him a valuable and inspiring member of the crew in the world of Narcalid.

Katya
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/b3458cada7b3dcbc0a0c2a8cb86715b531bd81c1.png
Katya Chepliev is a brilliant and determined young scientist from the Republic of Zheltyak, now part of the SS Awakening crew. Her journey is fueled by a quest for knowledge and a desire to honor her late parents' legacy. Despite her impressive intellect and accomplishments, she grapples with emotional struggles, making her a complex and compelling character in the world of Narcalid.

Frank
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/211bf6d0b397321674c91a1e5f272a4c7dfacd6c.png
Frank Barley is a dedicated and humble orbital waste disposal technician from the Union of Sol Invictus, serving aboard the SS Awakening. His practical skills and loyalty make him a vital, though often overlooked, member of the crew. Frank's journey reflects his struggle with feelings of unworthiness and his desire to be recognized without seeking personal glory in the world of Narcalid.

The Crew

Juliana
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/09e9637aa8086a87b9cf1fd9273bf66f8a397b68.gif
	Juliana eventually found her way onto the crew of the SS Awakening, where she serves as the ship's botanist and helps maintain the ships' hydroponic gardens. Despite her loner tendencies, she found a sense of belonging among the crew and continues to explore the universe, studying new and exotic plant life along the way. 

Koda
	When she heard about the colonization mission on a newly discovered planet, she jumped at the opportunity to join the SS Awakening crew. She was hired on as the team's animal specialist, and she was excited to see what kinds of creatures they would encounter on their journey.

Zara
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/a3850f649409dc2f13ad28120e686aba4756cf16.gif
	After breaking the code to translate 3 ancient languages, she was recruited to the colonization mission. She may come off as a bit creepy and gloomy to some, but those who take the time to get to know her will find that she is a down to earth and incredibly intelligent person.

Maecy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/3b6168ea03e6bac26ca5314f3dbd4745abd3cc74.gif
	Maecy is a stunning woman with a fierce attitude to match. She exudes confidence and sexiness, always making sure she looks her best. She can be a little self-centered, but her skills with weapons and her multitool make up for it. She's not one to mess with, as she'll quickly put anyone in their place with her sharp tongue and quick wit.

Aydin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/584e3ee61b79919ecf25a7f37d965813d0b51789.gif
	The Deluxe Flux was so well known that the Space Force took notice and asked her father despite his age to embark on a special mission with an elite team. This was big news for the Ammersmen family, and Rob of course accepted. They had 3 years to get things ready for this new exciting journey. Aydin would run the business while her father Rob was gone. Life had other plans…

Lero
	Despite his brilliance, Lero often struggles with social interactions and can come across as awkward or aloof. However, he is fiercely loyal to his crewmates and will do whatever it takes to protect them and ensure their safety. He also has a secret crush on Koda, but his lack of social skills often makes it difficult for him to express his feelings.

Hiro
	Hiro’s past is shrouded in mystery, even to those closest to him. He was once a highly respected doctor, known for his brilliant mind and unparalleled medical skills. However, his career was cut short when he was discharged from his practice for misconduct. To this day, no one knows the details of what happened, and Hiro himself refuses to speak about it. Despite his past, his expertise in medicine was too valuable to ignore, and he was recruited to join the crew of this colonization mission.

Magnus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/9ce89003c0eddcddefbc0835b4adcd9ca66461a8.gif
	Magnus's unique abilities caught the attention of a space exploration team, who were in search of a seer, intuition advisor, and spiritual guide for their crew. Magnus jumped at the opportunity to not only further his own understanding of the universe but also to help others to connect with the vibrations of the universe.

Ivan

	Despite what most people think, Ivan was never a born leader. While on a routine mission, surveying a moon in the Hubston quadrant, which is on the outskirts of our solar system, an unexpected meteor shower assailed their squad's spacecraft. The ship crashed on the moon. All 7 of the team members died save for Ivan and his commanding officer. Ivan would have died with his other squad members if it wasn’t for his commanding officer. Shortly after crashing his commanding officer passed away leaving Ivan alone on the moon for 3 weeks till a nearby cruiser arrived, answering the distress beacon.

Natives

Narcalids
	The Narcalids were a fearsome sight to behold. Their massive bodies were covered in thick exoskeleton armor, with giant legs that ended in razor sharp points. Their faces were angular and insect-like, with glowing eyes that seemed to see into the very soul of whoever they were looking at. 

Xi’Kai
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/48fe46050c403b9a233c47dc1cb071c7b9b4d0f7.gif
	The Xi'Kai, also known as the Wind Lords, are a graceful and agile race that inhabit the windswept plains of Avalaris. They are a cautious but curious race, always eager to engage in discussions with newcomers to their world. Despite their cautious nature, the Xi'Kai are open-minded and inquisitive, eager to learn about the cultures and technologies of other races. 

Umar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/b95a2f736f51f12d8369317c2094ba2194773bcd.gif
	The Umar are a once-advanced species. Their caution and distrust has degraded their people and as a result they have become secluded and isolated. With a spiny backs and jellyfish-like appearance, they rely on stealth and poison to protect their land. However, the growing corruption on their planet has forced them to share their territory with the Xi'kai, leading to ongoing negotiations between the two species.

Vylneth
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/c11a65d90592b262a7e35bc2e42453f8dfea7d01.gif
	The Vylneth or Crystal Spinners. These spider-like creatures burrowed down and found the crystal energy the Gravdiggers carry and fed off it mutating them into something else entirely. Now they lie deep in these caves entwining their crystals over every rock. Spinning beautiful but deadly crystal mazes only for travelers to be caught up in their diamond like webs.

Ashrie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/584e3ee61b79919ecf25a7f37d965813d0b51789.gif
	A once highly revered religious race/creature. Their thick outer shells like that of a beetle glistens gold and bronze. Their skin deep grays and blacks, long transparent wings look, at a distance, like flowing hair or a cloak. 

Ju’Sho
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/7442ae3ca4cd82efa68e92f50d03e93e8ac75982.gif
	Extremely industrious, building beautiful and lasting architecture and legacies. Their mark on the world is permanent. Their developments, while few, were great. Floating cities, indestructible building materials, writings and memories from the past that are still around.

notes.title: Narcalid's Enlightement #1 - Biomes & Locations
notes.content:
Hello spiritual adventurers!

As we get closer to the early access release of Narcalid in Q3 this year, we want to prepare everyone for the spiritual and enlightenment journey that waits in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Narcalid.

We will release a series of quick blog posts throughout the upcoming months exploring more about different aspects of the game that players can expect to find in the game while joining this spiritual adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697755/89fcde7d9a494eccb9c433dd411a3edb55e21f5b.png

Biomes & Locations

The ship
Founded by a group of visionary entrepreneurs and engineers, New Dawn Enterprises is at the forefront of technological advancements on Earth. With the knowledge that any number of Earthly or celestial disasters threaten the survival of humanity, New Dawn Enterprises sets out to lead the charge in colonizing new planets to ensure the continuation of the human race. The company invests heavily in research and development, from cutting-edge spacecraft technology to advanced terraforming methods.

New Dawn Enterprises assembles an elite team of scientists, engineers, and colonists to embark on a mission to a far-off planet with the goal of establishing a thriving, sustainable human colony. The company provides the team with state-of-the-art equipment, resources, and support, ensuring the success of the mission. With their vast resources and cutting-edge technology, New Dawn Enterprises has set the standard for space exploration and is widely regarded as the leader in the field.

[previewyoutube=PJAUFG8Rc4g;full][/previewyoutube]

Windswept Plains
Windswept plains is home to the Xi’Kai and other aviatory creatures and great plateaus. A Sky City of the ancients once resided here, but it has since moved south to the Razor Mountains on the back of an ancient storm being. The Corruption has affected this region the most, causing the Xi'Kai to migrate west to the Fungle Forests for refuge with the Umar. Many other forms of life in this biome are struggling to adapt as their food source dwindles. Some creatures venture into the Radiation Wastes for food but few return and those who do are sick and in need of aid.

[previewyoutube=lOFEvQQsibs;full][/previewyoutube]

The Fungal Forest
The Fungal Forest is filled with towering fluorescent plants, glowing ichor, and dust from the mushroom trees. However, please keep in mind that the forest should also have poisonous creatures, making it dangerous for players to navigate. The Umar are the primary inhabitants of the forest, and they rely on their small size and stealth to defend their territory. The Xi’Kai from the Windswept plains are seeking refuge from the corruption here, which may lead to negotiations between them and the Umar. Please ensure that the design incorporates the themes of enjoyment, safety, sociability, family structure, and community.

[previewyoutube=w8RaZ4TvQjk;full][/previewyoutube]

Caves
Not much is known how these dense crystalline caves were formed. Some say the Law Binder was angry and carved out her jagged furry deep into the earth leaving behind a network of beautiful, jutting, crystal shards coating every inch. Some say it was a foreign  sentient meteor that crashed into this earth forming deep caves before it died.. If at all.  Many who travel here are never seen again. Like a Fun house full of mirrors, travelers can easily get lost and turned around in a matter of minutes. What's worse is the crystal seems to move and change. None are quite sure if it's the actual crystals or the cryline spiders that spin their crystal webbing to form more. Be extra careful of those creatures. Or you’ll end up trapped as an added crystal to this maze.

[previewyoutube=iJZ-r1SJFrI;full][/previewyoutube]

Razor Mountains
Long ago this place was once a beautiful lush landscape. Now a jagged rocky dessert. Not much was left behind to give us answers to who, how, or why? But we have some possible hints. One was this land changed during the Great Scourge. Legend says The Shepherd slammed his staff and uprooted this valley entirely. Others link it to the Great Storm itself. A very ancient creature that roams this land. Either could be likely possibilities. The great storm, doom cloud, Realm Devourer. All fitting names for this odd tech storm. Moving about the desert unchallenged. Its miles long and generates enough electricity to power new york for 100 years. It leaves only ruin in its path. At the beginning of the age of the narcalids most in this region were nomadic and ran from the storm.

[previewyoutube=YjjCCIhSVEU;full][/previewyoutube]

Core
A great fissure is opened in the center of this desolate landscape. This has caused the land around to decay and die. No one has been able to stop it. And the planet is slowly dying because of it. Legend says the shepherd and the Orderbearer caused this destruction to happen out of anger towards their children. So great was the devastation that it began a new age for the planet, called The Scourge. Some say the Children of The Makers did this. Mining so far beneath the ground stripping resources that they inadvertently awoken some powerful being. Others claim it was a weapon of war gone wrong. Whatever the case its here now and as the legend goes. One must find the Makers Tear and heal this land.

[previewyoutube=Tg7Ya8WV3Co;full][/previewyoutube]

Base Area
Your safe place to explore collectibles, talk to other NPCs, and much more! There is also a dedicated spot to meditate and stay in tune with Narcalid enlightenments.
[previewyoutube=_ecBWlrbWYs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Premiere Developer Interview And Playthrough
notes.content:
Get a glimpse at the content coming in the Early Access launch of Narcalid in this sneak peak play-through and interview of the studio's founder and vision holder. 
Lotus Mountain Creative is a mission driven company with the aim to aide in the enlightenment of the universe. We feel like we are accomplishing that if we deliver on 3 things:

It brings joy!
It brings people together. 
It elevates consciousness.

There are many secrets and surprises awaiting you on your adventure through the mystic world of Avalaris!
